scope: Corollary 5.1 of the manuscript “Integrability of split tangent bundles on rationally connected manifolds” (preprints/Integrability-of-split-tangent-bundles-on-rationally-connected-manifolds-September-23-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 052 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 cb23bde917710f73), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let X be a connected uniruled compact Kähler manifold with a holomorphic splitting TX = V1 ⊕ V2. Let Z be a general fiber of its rationally connected quotient and set Wi = TZ ∩ Vi|Z. For each i = 1, 2, there is an almost-holomorphic fibration ϕi : X 99K Yi whose general fiber Fi is rationally connected and, for compatible choices Fi ⊂ Z, satisfies TFi = Wi|Fi ⊂ Vi|Fi . If Wi = 0, one may take ϕi = idX, with point fibers. If rank V1 = 2, exactly one of the following holds: (i) W1 = V1|Z, and X admits an analytic fiber bundle X → Y with rationally connected general fiber and TX/Y = V1. (ii) W1 is a line bundle, and there is an equidimensional holomorphic map X → Y whose general fiber F is a rational curve with TF ⊂ V1|F . (iii) W1 = 0, equivalently TZ ⊂ V2|Z.
